items.title: सरकार ने छात्र लैपटॉप योजना 2026 के अंतर्गत मुफ्त लैपटॉप वितरण के संदेश का खंडन किया
items.snippet_en: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check debunked messages claiming the government is distributing free laptops under a 'Student Laptop Scheme 2026', stating it is fake and a scam to collect personal information, with no such scheme announced.

items.title: Did 'government of India' invite applications for free laptops? PIB Fact Check debunks social media posts | Today News - Mint
items.snippet_en: Mint reported on September 21, 2026, that PIB Fact Check clarified the Government of India has not announced any 'National Student Laptop Scheme 2026' or invited applications for free laptops, warning such offers are often used by fraudsters.

items.title: National Student Laptop Scheme 2026: Viral message leaves students curious, PIB responds - The Economic Times
items.snippet_en: The Economic Times, on September 21, 2026, reported on the PIB Fact Check debunking a viral WhatsApp message about the 'National Student Laptop Scheme 2026', reiterating that no such government scheme exists and advising caution against fraudulent offers.

items.title: Free Laptop Scheme for Students in India 2026-27 - Buddy4Study
items.snippet_en: Buddy4Study, in an article updated on August 25, 2026, states there is no central government scheme providing free laptops to all students in India, and that PIB Fact Check has repeatedly debunked such claims as scams, with only state-level schemes existing.

items.title: PIB Fact Check: 'Free Laptop Scheme 2025' Under Narendra Modi Govt is Fake News
items.snippet_en: PIB Fact Check, on July 5, 2025, confirmed that a viral message claiming the Narendra Modi government is offering free laptops under a 'Free Laptop Scheme 2025' is fake and misleading, advising against clicking suspicious links.

items.title: प्रधानमंत्री मुफ्त लैपटॉप योजना की फर्जी खबरों के बारे में जागरूकता - AICTE
items.snippet_en: The All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) has issued an awareness notice regarding fake news about the 'Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme'.
